title: Mitochondria before we knew them
title_zh: 我们认识之前的线粒体
abstract: In this issue of Cell, Chen et al. chart mitochondrial proteome diversity across eukaryotes, revealing an unexpectedly complex ancestral proteome alongside extensive lineage-specific innovation. Their broad phylogenetic reconstruction provides new insights into the mitochondrial proteome of the last eukaryotic common ancestor while unearthing a wealth of unexplored mitochondrial biology outside of traditional model systems.
abstract_zh: 在《细胞》本期中，陈等人绘制了真核生物线粒体蛋白组的多样性，揭示了一个出乎意料的复杂祖先蛋白组，并伴随广泛的谱系特异性创新。他们的广泛系统发育重建为理解最后真核共同祖先的线粒体蛋白组提供了新见解，同时发掘了传统模式系统之外大量未被探索的线粒体生物学。
